sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def targets(frame):
    s={}
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('R','b','N') and n['pixels']==16:
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            key=n['color']
            s.setdefault(key,[]).append((min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)))
    return s
print('before', targets(current_frame))
action(['RIGHT'])
print('after', targets(current_frame))
print('score', last_action_result.get('score'), 'lc', last_action_result.get('level_completed'), 'done', last_action_result.get('done'))
# wire tip row 32
row = current_frame.ascii.splitlines()[32]
print('row32 tail:', row[38:48])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
